verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kugira gatandatu, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaciye ku wuvugishwa n’Imana Hagayi ribwirwa Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, na Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Aba bantu bavuga bati: ‘Igihe ntikiragera co gusubira kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .’ ”
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza riciye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi riti:
“Mbega iki ni igihe c’uko mwebwe mwibera mu mazu yanyu asharije kandi yubatse neza, ariko Ingoro yanje yoyo ikaguma ari umusaka?”
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nimwiyumvire neza ku nzira zanyu.

Mwateye vyinshi, ariko mwimbuye bike. Murarya, ariko ntimwigera muhaga. Muranywa, ariko ntimwigera mushira inyota. Murambara, ariko ntimushira imbeho. Muronka imishahara mukayishira mu mifuko itobotse.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nimugenzure inzira zanyu.
Nimuduge mu misozi muzane ibiti maze mwubake Ingoro yanje, kugira ngo inezereze kandi impeshe icubahiro,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Mwari mwiteze kwimbura vyinshi, ariko raba, mwimbuye bike. Ivyo mwashikanye mu ngo ntuma bikeha. Ni kubera iki?” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza. “Ni kubera inzu yanje, yagumye ari umusaka, mu gihe umwe wese muri mwebwe yitwararitse kwubaka neza inzu yiwe.
Nuko rero, kubera mwebwe, ikirere carabimye urume, eka n’isi yarabimye ivyimburwa.
Nahamagaye uruzuba ngo ruze ku mirima, ku misozi, ku ngano, ku mizabibu, ku mavuta ya elayo ku bindi vyimburwa vyose isi itanga, ku bantu no ku bitungano, no ku vyo mwaruhiye vyose.”

Nuko Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, n’amasigarira yose, bumvira ijwi ry’ Uhoraho Imana yabo n’ubutumwa bw’uwavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yabo yari yamutumye. Abantu bubaha Uhoraho .
Maze Hagayi, intumwa y’ Uhoraho , ashikiriza abantu ubu butumwa buvuye k’ Uhoraho buvuga ngo: “Ndi kumwe namwe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Nuko Uhoraho akangura umutima wa Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, n’umutima wa Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, n’umutima w’amasigarira yo mu bantu. Baraza batangura kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana yabo,
ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kugira gatandatu. Mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma,

headings.text: Hagayi atera intege abantu ngo bubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho

verses.text: Ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na rimwe w’ukwezi kugira indwi, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riraza riciye mu wavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi, rivuga riti:
“Vugana na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, na Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, n’amasigarira yose y’abo bantu. Ubabaze uti:
‘Ni nde muri mwebwe agisigaye yoba yarabonye iyi Ngoro mu bwiza bwayo bwa kera? Mbega ubu isa gute? Mbega ntisa n’aho ari ubusa?’

‘Ariko ubu rero shikama, yewe Zerubabeli,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. ‘Shikama, yewe Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru. Nimushikame mukomere, namwe bantu mwese muri mu gihugu,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘maze mukore. Kuko ndi kumwe namwe,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Ibi ni vyo nasezeranye namwe igihe mwava muri Egiputa. Kandi Mpwemu wanje aguma hagati muri mwebwe. Ntimutinye.’
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Mu gihe gito nzosubira kunyiganyiza amajuru n’isi, ikiyaga n’i musozi.’
Nzonyiganyiza amahanga yose, kandi ivyo amahanga yose yipfuza bizoza, maze nzokwuzuza ubwiza iyi Ngoro, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Ifeza ni izanje n’inzahabu ni izanje,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Ubwiza bw’iyi Ngoro buzoruta ubw’iya kera,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. ‘Kandi nzozana amahoro aha hantu,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.”
Ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kw’icenda, mu mwaka ugira kabiri Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza riciye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Baza abaherezi uko ivyagezwe bivuga:

Umuntu niyatwara inyama zeguriwe Imana mu muzingo w’impuzu wiwe, maze uwo muzingo ugakora ku mukate canke imboga, umuvinyu, amavuta ya elayo canke ibindi vyokurya vyose, mbega ivyo na vyo nyene bizoca biba ivyeguriwe Imana?’ ” Maze abaherezi barishura bati: “Oya.”
Maze Hagayi aravuga ati: “Umuntu yahumanijwe no gukora ku muvyimba akoze kuri kimwe muri ivyo, mbega gica gihumana?” Ba baherezi barishura bati: “gica gihumana.”
Maze Hagayi aravuga ati: “ ‘Ni ko bimeze no kuri aba bantu no kuri iri hanga mu nyonga zanje,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. ‘Ivyo bakora vyose n’ivyo bashikana vyose biranduye.’
None rero nimwiyumvire kuri ibi uhereye uno musi, mwibuke igihe ata buye ryari bwagerekwe ku rindi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Umuntu yaja kurondera ingero mirongo ibiri mu kigega z’ingano, yasangamwo ingero cumi gusa. Uwaja kurondera ingero mirongo itanu z’umuvinyu mu bwato bwo kuganiramwo, yasangamwo ingero mirongo ibiri gusa.
Nateje igikorwa c’amaboko yanyu kurumba, ukubora n’urubura, ariko na ho nyene ntimwangarutseko, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
‘Kuva uwu musi, umusi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kugira icenda, mwiyumvire cane ku musi itanguriro ry’uru rusengero rw’ Uhoraho ryashirwaho. Mwiyumvire neza:
Mbega hari n’imbuto zisigaye mu bigega? Kugeza ubu, umuzabibu, n’umusukoni, umukomamanga n’umwelayo ntivyamye ivyamwa vyavyo. Uhereye kuri uwu musi nzobahezagira.’ ”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riraza riciye kuri Hagayi ubugira kabiri ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na kane w’uko kwezi nyene, riti:
“Bwira Zerubabeli umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda ko ngiye kunyiganyiza amajuru n’isi.
Nzotembagaza intebe z’ubwami nsangangure ubushobozi bw’amahanga. Nzotembagaza imikogote n’abayigenderako; amafarasi n’abayagenderako bizotemba, umwe wese yicwe n’inkota y’umuvukanyi wiwe.

‘Kuri uwo musi,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, ‘nzogutwara, wewe Zerubabeli umusavyi wanje mwene Sheyalutiyeli,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘maze ndakugire nk’impeta yo ku rutoke rwanje, kuko nagutoranije,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.”
